title: Unlocking UAP Mysteries: Economics, Aliens, and The Great Filter | Merged EP0109
summary: A 146-minute Merged Podcast episode in which UAP researcher Ryan Graves talks with economist Robin Hanson about UFOs. Topics include the Great Filter, Hanson's grabby aliens model, and the push for more inquiry into UAPs.
why: HN commenters point to it for Hanson's grabby aliens reasoning as an unusual framework for thinking about UFO behavior and intelligent life in the cosmos.

quote.text: Grabby Aliens concept by Robin Hanson is an interesting new take on UFOs.
